source:
@@U02815@@
If I had tongues of fire they would not serve!
When Beauty, forever the poet's inspiration,
comes, the singer is driven beyond himself,
and he who possesses her
has known too much of joy.

@@U02817@@
Do I still have eyes?
Or is it deep in my soul
I see Beauty’s wellspring in full stream?
My quest of terror has brought me a blissful reward.
How without meaning,
how closed the world was to me!
But my priesthood has made it desirable,
well founded, enduring!
May the breath of life desert me
if I resign myself to living without you.
The fair form that bewitched me long ago
in a magic reflection
was a mere mocking counterfeit of this Beauty.
I pledge to you herewith, as tribute due,
the sum of my strength,
the quintessence of passion,
affection, love, adoration, madness!

@@U02819@@
(From the prompter’ box.)

@@U02820@@
Control yourself!
Remember, you're acting!

@@U02822@@
Tall, well built, only the head too small.

@@U02824@@
Look at her feet.
How coarse they are.
translation:
@@U02815@@
如果我有火舌，他们就不会服务！
当美，永远是诗人的灵感，
来了，歌手被超越了自己，
和拥有她的他
已经懂得了太多的快乐。

@@U02817@@
我还有眼睛吗？
还是在我的灵魂深处
我看到美丽的源泉源源不断地流淌？
我对恐怖的追求给我带来了幸福的回报。
怎样毫无意义，
世界对我是多么封闭啊！
但我的祭司职分让它变得令人向往，
有根有据，经久不衰！
愿生命的气息抛弃我
如果我屈服于没有你的生活。
很久以前就让我着迷的美丽形式
在神奇的倒影中
只不过是对这位美女的嘲弄赝品。
我谨此向您保证，作为应有的敬意，
我的力量的总和，
激情的精髓，
亲情、爱、崇拜、疯狂！

@@U02819@@
（来自提示框。）

@@U02820@@
控制住自己！
记住，你是在演戏！

@@U02822@@
身材高大，身材匀称，只是头太小了。

@@U02824@@
看看她的脚。
它们是多么粗糙啊。
